Sales Manager (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz (Kulm Hotel), St. Moritz (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Unbefristet / Permanent. Start: 2026-11-01.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture: | This is what you move with us: As part of the strategic realignment of our Brand & Commercial Team, we are transforming our Events & Sales business from a reactive to a proactive approach. • Proactive Market Development: Transform reactive business into proactive sales initiatives and acquire new clients in the leisure sales segment.

• Experience & Drive: A proven track record in luxury hospitality sales and a genuine passion for business development. An established industry network is a strong advantage.

• Languages (Must-Have): Fluent and confident in negotiations in at least two languages, with German or English as a base language, plus additional languages relevant to your target markets.

• Willingness to Travel & Flexibility: Comfortable with international sales trips and flexible in supporting and hosting clients on-site.

• Your Profile: A confident negotiator with a strong closing mindset and solid experience with modern CRM and PMS systems.

• Room to Make an Impact: The opportunity to contribute your own ideas, creativity and initiatives.

• Excellent Working Conditions: A modern workplace at Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, attractive staff benefits and employee accommodation in the Engadin.

• Ready for the Next Step in Your Career? We look forwad to receiving your application! | Benefits: At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture: | This is what you move with us:
• Daily Inspection & Quality Assurance: You will supervise and ensure the immaculate cleanliness of our luxurious guest rooms, residence apartments, and staff quarters. Your daily inspections guarantee that every space meets the highest standards of the Kulm Quality Standards, Swiss Deluxe Hotels, and Leading Hotels of the World.

• Material Care & Discretion: You strictly adhere to the regulations for cleaning various materials and ensure the highest level of discretion in all matters concerning our guests and the hotel.

• Commitment & Passion: Your attention to detail, ability to prioritize, and motivation to always deliver the best set you apart. jobs.title: Executive Housekeeping Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Executive Housekeeping Manager (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz (Grand Hotel Kronenhof), Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Unbefristet / Permanent. Start: 2026-11-01.

Where historic charm meets modern luxury – Grand Hotel Kronenhof in Pontresina is one of the most renowned 5-star superior hotels in Switzerland. Overlooking the fascinating Engadin mountain scenery, we celebrate hospitality at the highest level. To perfectly present this magical place for our guests, we are looking for a personality who has cleanliness, elegance and leadership in their blood. | This is what you move with us: As Executive Housekeeper, you are the driving force behind the impeccable appearance of our hotel. You report directly to the Rooms Division Manager and lead an international team of approximately 24 employees.

• Quality assurance at 5-star level: You ensure impeccable cleanliness and living quality in all guest rooms and public areas – always in line with the demanding standards of Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Forbes and Leading Quality Assurance (LQA). You are also responsible for our staff accommodation.

• Inspiring leadership: You are a coach and role model for your team. You are responsible for staff scheduling, conduct training sessions (equipment and cleaning procedures), carry out performance reviews and are actively involved in the recruitment process of new talents.

• Efficient management & logistics: You manage inventory, oversee the purchasing of hotel linen and uniforms, and coordinate the smooth laundry process in close cooperation with our sister hotel, Kulm.

• Interface professional: You are in daily contact with the Executive Management, Engineering, Floristry and Front Office to ensure smooth housekeeping operations. | This is you:
• Your foundation: Completed vocational training in the hotel industry (Hotel Management Specialist) or a professional qualification in Housekeeping Management, ideally complemented by specific further training.

• Your experience: Several years of management experience in Housekeeping, preferably in the 5-star hotel industry. The position is suitable for both experienced managers and committed junior managers who are ready to take the next step in their career.

• Your language skills: Must-have: Fluent German or English. Advantageous: Knowledge of Italian and/or Portuguese.

• Your personality: You are characterised by a keen eye for detail, strong business acumen, excellent organisational skills and absolute discretion.

• Start date: Flexible, by agreement.
What we offer:

• Affordable staff accommodation in Pontresina or Samedan.

• A workplace in one of the most beautiful locations in the Swiss Alps.

• Room for personal responsibility and extensive decision-making authority within your area.

• A motivated, interdisciplinary team and an excellent working environment in one of the top Swiss Deluxe Hotels.
Ready for the next step in your career? If you are ready for this challenge and would like to keep our Housekeeping team on the path to success, we look forward to receiving your comprehensive application. | Benefits: At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Executive Housekeeping Manager (m/f/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz (Grand Hotel Kronenhof), Pontresina (Engadin, Grigioni). Carico di lavoro: 100%. Contratto: Unbefristet / Permanente. Inizio: 2026-10-01.

Dove il fascino storico incontra il lusso moderno – il Grand Hotel Kronenhof di Pontresina è uno dei più famosi hotel 5 stelle superior in Svizzera. Affacciato sull'affascinante paesaggio montano Engadin, celebriamo l'ospitalità al massimo livello. Per presentare perfettamente questo luogo magico per i nostri ospiti, stiamo cercando una personalità che ha pulizia, eleganza e leadership nel loro sangue. # Questo è ciò che si muove con noi: come Executive Housekeeper, sei la forza trainante dietro l'aspetto impeccabile del nostro hotel. Si segnala direttamente al Rooms Division Manager e guida un team internazionale di circa 24 dipendenti.

• Garanzia di qualità a 5 stelle: garantisce una pulizia impeccabile e una qualità di vita in tutte le camere e aree pubbliche – sempre in linea con gli standard esigenti di Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Forbes e Leading Quality Assurance (LQA). Siete anche responsabili per il nostro alloggio personale.

• Leader d'ispirazione: Sei un coach e un modello di ruolo per il tuo team. Siete responsabili della pianificazione del personale, delle sessioni di formazione di condurre (equipment e procedure di pulizia), delle recensioni sulle prestazioni e siete attivamente coinvolti nel processo di reclutamento di nuovi talenti.

• Gestione efficiente e logistica: gestisci l'inventario, sovrintende l'acquisto di biancheria d'albergo e uniformi, e coordina il processo di lavanderia liscio in stretta collaborazione con il nostro hotel sorella, Kulm.

• Interfaccia professionale: Lei è in contatto quotidiano con la Direzione Esecutivo, Ingegneria, Floristry e Front Office per garantire le operazioni di pulizia liscia. # Questo sei tu:
• La vostra fondazione: Formazione professionale completa nel settore alberghiero (Hotel Management Specialist) o una qualifica professionale in Housekeeping Management, idealmente completato da specifica formazione ulteriore.

• La vostra esperienza: Diversi anni di esperienza di gestione in Housekeeping, preferibilmente nel settore alberghiero a 5 stelle. La posizione è adatta sia ai manager esperti che ai manager impegnati che sono pronti a compiere il prossimo passo nella loro carriera.

• Le tue competenze linguistiche: Must-have: Tedesco fluente o inglese. Vantaggio: Conoscenza dell'italiano e/o del portoghese.

• La vostra personalità: siete caratterizzati da un occhio attento ai dettagli, acume aziendale forte, eccellenti capacità organizzative e assoluta discrezione.

• Data d'inizio: dal 1 ottobre o d'accordo.
Cosa offriamo:

• Alloggio personale conveniente a Pontresina o Samedan.

• Un posto di lavoro in una delle località più belle delle Alpi svizzere.

• Sala per la responsabilità personale e l'ampio potere decisionale all'interno della vostra area.

• Un team motivato e interdisciplinare e un ambiente di lavoro eccellente in uno dei migliori hotel di lusso svizzeri.
Pronto per il prossimo passo nella tua carriera? Se siete pronti per questa sfida e volete mantenere il nostro team di pulizia sulla strada del successo, non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione completa. A Kulm Group, i nostri dipendenti sono il cuore del nostro successo. Offriamo interessanti opportunità di sviluppo, sistemazioni confortevoli, pasti convenienti nel ristorante del personale, e numerosi vantaggi.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung Executive Housekeeping Manager (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz (Grand Hotel Kronenhof), Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Pensum: 100%.

Wo historisches Flair auf modernen Luxus trifft – das Grand Hotel Kronenhof in Pontresina ist eines der renommiertesten 5-Sterne-Superior-Hotels der Schweiz. Mit Blick auf die faszinierende Engadiner Bergwelt feiern wir Gastfreundschaft auf höchstem Niveau. Um diesen magischen Ort unseren Gästen perfekt zu präsentieren, suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Sauberkeit, Eleganz und Führung im Blut hat., Das ist es, was Sie bei uns bewegen: Als Executive Housekeeper sind Sie die treibende Kraft hinter dem tadellosen Erscheinungsbild unseres Hotels.

Sie melden sich direkt beim Rooms Division Manager und führen ein internationales Team von rund 24 Mitarbeitern.

Verantwortung - Qualitätssicherung auf 5-Sterne-Ebene: Sie sorgen für einwandfreie Sauberkeit und Wohnqualität in allen Gästezimmern und öffentlichen Bereichen – immer im Einklang mit den anspruchsvollen Standards von Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Forbes und Leading Quality Assurance (LQA). Sie sind auch für unsere Mitarbeiter-Unterkünfte verantwortlich. - Inspirierende Führung: Sie sind ein Trainer und Vorbild für Ihr Team. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Personalplanung, die Durchführung von Schulungen (Ausrüstungs- und Reinigungsverfahren), die Durchführung von Leistungsüberprüfungen und die aktive Beteiligung am Rekrutierungsprozess neuer Talente.

- Effizientes Management & Logistik: Sie verwalten den Bestand, überwachen den Einkauf von Hotelwäsche und -uniformen und koordinieren den reibungslosen Waschprozess in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Schwesterhotel Kulm. - Interface Professional: Sie stehen täglich mit der Geschäftsleitung, dem Engineering, der Floristie und dem Front Office in Kontakt, um einen reibungslosen Hauswirtschaftsbetrieb zu gewährleisten.

Voraussetzungen - Ihre Gründung: Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in der Hotellerie (Hotelmanagement-Spezialist) oder eine berufliche Qualifikation in der Hauswirtschaft, ideal ergänzt durch eine spezifische Weiterbildung. - Ihre Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Management-Erfahrung in der Hauswirtschaft, vorzugsweise in der 5-Sterne-Hotellerie. Die Position ist geeignet für erfahrene Manager und engagierte Juniormanager, die bereit sind, den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere zu machen. - Ihre Sprachkenntnisse: Muss: fließend Deutsch oder Englisch. Vorteilhaft: Italienisch- und/oder Portugiesischkenntnisse.

- Ihre Persönlichkeit: Sie zeichnen sich durch ein scharfes Auge für Details, starke Geschäftswelt, hervorragende organisatorische Fähigkeiten und absolute Diskretion aus. - Startdatum: Ab 1. Oktober oder nach Absprache.

Was wir bieten - Preiswerte Mitarbeiterunterkünfte in Pontresina oder Samedan. - Ein Arbeitsplatz an einem der schönsten Orte der Schweizer Alpen. - Raum für persönliche Verantwortung und umfangreiche Entscheidungskompetenz in Ihrer Region. - Ein motiviertes, interdisziplinäres Team und ein hervorragendes Arbeitsumfeld in einem der Top Swiss Deluxe Hotels. - Bereit für den nächsten Karriereschritt? Wenn Sie bereit sind für diese Herausforderung und unser Housekeeping-Team auf dem Weg zum Erfolg halten möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre umfassende Bewerbung.

Vorteile - Unsere Mitarbeiter bei der Kulm Gruppe sind das Herzstück unseres Erfolgs. Wir bieten attraktive Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, komfortable Unterkünfte, günstige Mahlzeiten im Personalrestaurant und zahlreiche Vorteile.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Directeur exécutif du ménage (h/f/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz (Grand Hôtel Kronenhof), Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Charge de travail: 100%. Contrat: Unbefristet / Permanent. Début: 2026-10-01.

Où le charme historique rencontre le luxe moderne – le Grand Hotel Kronenhof de Pontresina est l'un des hôtels 5 étoiles les plus renommés de Suisse. Surplombant le paysage fascinant de la montagne Engadin, nous célébrons l'hospitalité au plus haut niveau. Pour présenter parfaitement cet endroit magique pour nos invités, nous cherchons une personnalité qui a la propreté, l'élégance et le leadership dans leur sang. - Oui. C'est ce que vous emménagez avec nous: En tant que chef de maison, vous êtes la force motrice derrière l'apparence impeccable de notre hôtel. Vous rendez compte directement au gestionnaire de la Division des salles et dirigez une équipe internationale d'environ 24 employés.

• Assurance qualité au niveau 5 étoiles: Vous garantissez une propreté et une qualité de vie impeccables dans toutes les chambres et tous les espaces publics – toujours en conformité avec les normes exigeantes des Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Forbes et Leading Quality Assurance (LQA). Vous êtes également responsable de notre hébergement personnel.

• Leadership inspirant: Vous êtes un entraîneur et un modèle pour votre équipe. Vous êtes responsable de la planification du personnel, de la tenue de séances de formation (procédures d'équipement et de nettoyage), de l'examen du rendement et de la participation active au processus de recrutement de nouveaux talents.

• Gestion et logistique efficaces: Vous gérez l'inventaire, supervisez l'achat de linge d'hôtel et d'uniformes, et coordonnez le processus de blanchisserie en étroite collaboration avec notre hôtel soeur, Kulm.

• Interface professionnelle: Vous êtes en contact quotidien avec la Direction générale, l'ingénierie, la flore et le Front Office pour assurer des opérations de ménage en douceur. - Oui. C'est vous:
• Votre fondation: Formation professionnelle complète dans l'industrie hôtelière (spécialiste de la gestion hôtelière) ou qualification professionnelle en management ménager, idéalement complétée par une formation complémentaire spécifique.

• Votre expérience: Plusieurs années d'expérience en gestion dans le ménage, de préférence dans l'industrie hôtelière 5 étoiles. Le poste est adapté à la fois aux gestionnaires expérimentés et aux gestionnaires subalternes engagés qui sont prêts à franchir la prochaine étape de leur carrière.

• Vos compétences linguistiques: Doit-avoir: Anglais ou allemand. Avantages: Connaissance de l'italien et/ou du portugais.

• Votre personnalité: Vous êtes caractérisé par un œil vif pour le détail, un sens fort des affaires, d'excellentes compétences organisationnelles et une discrétion absolue.

• Date de début: A partir du 1er octobre ou par accord.
Ce que nous offrons:
